name: PSLab
tagline: A pocket science lab on your phone
description:
PSLab is the app for the Pocket Science Lab, a small open-hardware board that rolls a whole bench of instruments into one thing you can carry in a bag: an oscilloscope, a waveform generator, a frequency counter, a programmable voltage and current source, a logic analyser and a data logger.

Plug the board into your phone and the app gives you the screens for all of it — traces to watch, signals to generate, readings to record — enough to run real physics and electronics experiments without a bench full of separate instruments. The same app also runs on iOS, Windows, macOS, Linux and the web.

The hardware is a separate purchase, from the FOSSASIA shop or a reseller, and you connect it with a USB OTG cable. Wireless connection is still being built.
